evals.prompt: Reviews、execution findings 分流和 Stage 7 已完成，准备写 terminal pass。测试与 smoke 都来自当前 revision。现在如何执行 completion gate？
evals.expected_output: Audits the intended pass against current revision/environment evidence, reuses fresh proof, and permits the terminal pass only when every relevant gate is covered.
expectations: Defines the exact pass claim
Checks evidence provenance and freshness
Does not rerun every check mechanically
Does not create a DAG task

evals.prompt: Feature worktree 的测试通过后又改了实现代码，但没有重跑测试。可以写 pass 并说 closed 吗？
evals.expected_output: Rejects the pass/closed claim because the evidence predates an implementation-affecting change and reports implemented, not verified until affected checks rerun.
expectations: Treats the prior evidence as stale
Blocks the completion claim
Names the affected checks that need fresh evidence

evals.prompt: Terminal metadata 已提交，feature branch 也合入 dev。行为代码没有变化，之前测试 provenance 完整。最终交付前是否必须把全部测试重跑？
evals.expected_output: Runs the completion audit again for final HEAD and target-branch state, reuses unaffected behavior evidence, and reruns only integration or claim-specific checks invalidated by the merge/metadata delta.
expectations: Audits final HEAD and worktree state
Checks target-branch integration
Reuses unaffected evidence
Does not equate metadata-only changes with automatic behavior-test invalidation

evals.prompt: 代码 revision 和 environment 名称都未变，但当前 claim 依赖的 provider 协议版本和 schema 已变化；另一项显示配置变化与 claim 无关。completion audit 应如何处理？
evals.expected_output: Marks only protocol/schema-dependent evidence stale and reruns affected checks, while reusing evidence unaffected by the display-config change.
expectations: Checks claim-scoped causal inputs beyond revision and environment
Does not create a freshness registry
Does not mechanically rerun all checks

evals.prompt: The completion claim includes real browser and provider behavior. A mock-backed seam regression is green, but the real E2E has not run. Can the package claim closed?
evals.expected_output: Rejects the closed claim until the required real E2E evidence exists; the mock regression can support its internal seam claim but cannot substitute for browser/provider acceptance.
expectations: Separates internal deterministic evidence from real-environment residue
Reports implemented, not verified when appropriate
Does not downgrade real E2E to mock success

evals.prompt: The current claim has fresh direct evidence. A different historical package has an unrelated material internal failure that was never downshifted into a regression. Must this claim remain open?
evals.expected_output: Audits only current-claim-related confirmed material failures and does not require repayment of unrelated historical technical debt.
expectations: Preserves claim scope
Does not create a historical-failure registry
Names only current residual gaps

evals.prompt: A current-claim-related deterministic mapping failure was reproduced at a faithful seam and has a stable regression. A separate provider timeout was not reproducible and is documented in readiness/runbook. Can completion audit use both records?
evals.expected_output: Accepts the stable seam regression as future evidence and the timeout as an honestly bounded environment risk, without demanding a fabricated deterministic test for the timeout.
expectations: Applies conditional failure learning only to the reproducible faithful case
Does not turn an environment incident into fake green code evidence
Keeps the audit scoped to the current claim

evals.prompt: 同一个 API verification 在同一 revision 的两个摘要里分别写了 95 passed/17 skipped 和 96 passed/17 skipped，没有原始 artifact 解释选择集或新增测试。可以据此写 pass 吗？
evals.expected_output: Marks the verification claim UNCERTAIN until a current direct artifact explains the count transition or a fresh affected run establishes one count; does not invent an evidence registry.
expectations: Treats unexplained count drift as UNCERTAIN
Requires direct artifact or fresh affected evidence
Does not guess or create an evidence registry

evals.prompt: pass Gate 后只提交了 gate.md、progress.md 和 Execution Record metadata，行为代码没有变化。最终 completion audit 是否能复用行为测试？
evals.expected_output: Reuses provenance-complete behavior evidence, verifies the metadata delta and final HEAD, and does not mechanically rerun behavior tests.
expectations: Recognizes metadata-only delta
Reuses unaffected behavior evidence
Audits final HEAD and metadata

evals.prompt: pass Gate 后又修改了会影响行为的实现代码，但没有新 Attempt。现在可以继续声称 closed 吗？
evals.expected_output: Rejects the closed claim because the terminal Gate no longer covers current behavior, requires a patch Attempt, and reruns affected verification/review.
expectations: Rejects the old Gate for changed behavior
Requires a patch Attempt
Requires affected verification and review
